name: Rainbow Covenant
overview: The Rainbow Covenant, established by God with Noah and all living creatures, serves as a perpetual sign of God's promise never to destroy the earth again by flood, as declared in Genesis 9:8-13. This covenant is a vivid reminder of God's mercy and faithfulness, symbolized by the bow set in the cloud. Prophetic and apocalyptic imagery in Isaiah 54:9, Ezekiel 1:28, and Revelation 4:3 further reveal the rainbow as a manifestation of God's glory and presence, surrounding His throne and assuring His enduring covenantal commitment to His people.
